devdoc.details: This contract implements IOracleProvider interface and converts Pyth price feeds      to the standard ValidatedPrice format with min/max price bounds based on confidence intervals

Pyth__EmptyPriceFeed(address).custom:error: Pyth__EmptyPriceFeed Thrown when no price feed ID is configured for the token

params.token: The token address that has no price feed configured

Pyth__InvalidPrice(int64,int32).custom:error: Pyth__InvalidPrice Thrown when price is negative or exponent is out of valid range

Pyth__InvalidScale(int32).custom:error: Pyth__InvalidScale Thrown when exponent is outside the valid range [-18, 18]

Pyth__Unauthorized(address,string).custom:error: Pyth__Unauthorized Thrown when a function is called by an unauthorized address

params.role: The required role that the sender lacks
params.sender: The address that attempted the unauthorized action

Pyth_OwnerSet(address).custom:event: Pyth_OwnerSet Emitted when the owner is changed

Pyth_PriceFeedIdSet(address,bytes32).custom:event: Pyth_PriceFeedIdSet Emitted when a price feed ID is set for a token

params.priceFeedId: The Pyth price feed ID for the token

constructor.details: Sets the owner, decimals, and Pyth oracle address

params._decimals: The number of decimals for price scaling

getOraclePrice(address,bytes).details: Fetches price from Pyth, converts it to the target decimals, and calculates      min/max bounds using the confidence interval. The timestamp is taken from      Pyth's publishTime.

params.token: The token address to get the price for

returns._0: ValidatedPrice struct containing token, min price, max price, timestamp, and provider address

setOwner(address).details: Only callable by the current owner. Emits Pyth_OwnerSet event.

params.newOwner: The address to transfer ownership to

setPriceFeedId(address,bytes32).details: Only callable by the owner. Emits Pyth_PriceFeedIdSet event.

params.priceFeedId: The Pyth price feed ID for the token
